content:
The test image shows a soybean field with patchy, uneven plant growth. Some plants appear stunted or dead, with visible soil gaps. This suggests a root/soil-borne disease causing poor stand. Top candidates: Soybean_Cyst_Nematode (patchy stunting), Sudden_death_syndrome, Phytophthora, or Pythium_damping_off.

Let me view reference images one at a time.
SCN reference shows close-up roots with white cysts. Test image is a field view with patchy stands. Let me check the field-level SCN reference and Sudden Death Syndrome.
SCN here shows yellowing foliage. Test image has sparse/dead plants, not yellowing. Let me check Sudden Death Syndrome.
SDS shows interveinal necrosis on leaves. Not matching the test field view. Let me check Pythium damping off.
Pythium shows seedling close-up. Not matching. Let me check Charcoal Rot (hot/dry conditions = wilting/dying plants in field) and Phytophthora.
Charcoal Rot shows microscopic stem tissue. Let me check Phytophthora field symptoms.
Phytophthora shows wilted/dead plant in wet muddy soil. Test image has dry/sandy soil with sparse patchy stand. Let me check the third SCN reference for field-level patchy view.
SCN reference 3 shows yellowing with gaps in stand. Matches test image somewhat. I have 1 view remaining. Let me check Charcoal Rot field-level view to compare.

**Analysis summary:**

- **Test image**: Field-level view, sandy/dry soil, patchy sparse soybean stand with small plants and visible gaps. Plants mostly green but some stunted. No obvious leaf spots, brown lesions, or dramatic wilting.
- **SCN (refs 27 & 32)**: Field views showing patchy yellowing and reduced stand with gaps in soil — closest visual match to test image.
- **Charcoal Rot (ref 10)**: Field-level patchy death in sandy soil, but more dramatic browning/death than test image.
- **Phytophthora**: Wet soil, dramatic wilting — doesn't match dry/sandy conditions.
- **SDS**: Interveinal necrosis on leaves — not present in test image.
- **Pythium**: Seedling-stage close-up — not matching.

The test image best matches Soybean Cyst Nematode: patchy field stand with stunted/sparse plants in dry sandy soil, consistent with SCN causing reduced root function and uneven above-ground growth.
